scientific_integrity: The continuous-parameter optimality and the stationary time-average central limit theorem are proved analytically in RESULT.md. The finite checker does not certify infinite-time theorems. The exact stationary process and moment identities are known background; the assessed claim is the sharp signed-factor frequency-resolved optimum and its threshold. Source comparisons do not establish global publication uniqueness.
scientific_limitations: Stationary one-dimensional Brownian diffusion with deterministic signed contraction -1<a<1 at independent Poisson reset epochs of fixed rate r>0. The high-frequency optimal spectral value is not attained within the stationary model. No result is asserted for joint rate optimization, spectral bands, refractory times, noise with memory, transient spectra, or stochastic resetting factors.
title: Sharp frequency-dependent resetting design for a diffusive particle
